description: The file 'reqImport.php' is part of the TestLink open-source test management project. It handles requirements import functionality, supporting formats such as CSV, XML, and DocBook. The script manages file uploads, parsing, and importing of requirements and requirement specifications. It defines functions for processing XML data, handling file uploads, and managing import contexts, as well as initializing user interface elements and access rights.

methods.name: doExecuteImport
methods.description: Performs the entire import process based on uploaded file and import type, including moving the uploaded file, parsing XML if needed, and calling appropriate import functions.

methods.name: doReqImportFromXML
methods.description: Creates requirement objects from XML data, handling both requirement specifications and individual requirements.

methods.name: doReqImportOther
methods.description: Handles importing requirements from non-XML formats by loading the exported data and creating requirement objects accordingly.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the user interface object with relevant configuration, import types, and URLs based on user permissions and scope.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for the current context to ensure access control.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request and session parameters to determine the requested action and import options.
